EPICOR KINETIC ERP IMPLEMENTATION AND CUSTOMIZATION CONSULTANT

CONTRACT ONLY

IMPORTANT CANDIDATE REQUIREMENT

This opportunity is specifically for candidates with direct, hands on Epicor Kinetic ERP implementation and customization experience.

Please apply only if your background includes configuring and customizing Epicor Kinetic. General ERP experience, software development experience, or experience with other ERP platforms does not meet this requirement by itself.

Your resume must clearly show your Epicor Kinetic experience and the customizations you personally completed.

Position Summary

Petrotech is seeking an experienced Epicor Kinetic consultant for a project based contract engagement supporting our Epicor Kinetic ERP implementation, with a strong focus on customization within the application.

The consultant must be able to step into an active environment, understand business requirements, configure and customize Epicor Kinetic, test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and contribute with minimal ramp up time.

Required Epicor Kinetic Experience

Direct, recent, hands on experience implementing Epicor Kinetic ERP.
Direct hands on experience customizing Epicor Kinetic within the application using Application Studio.
Experience creating and maintaining Business Activity Queries, Business Process Management workflows, Epicor Functions, user defined fields or tables, validations, and business rules in Epicor Kinetic.
Experience taking Epicor Kinetic customizations from business requirement through configuration or development, testing, deployment, and issue resolution.
Working experience with Epicor Kinetic REST APIs, integrations, SQL, data mapping, or relational data troubleshooting as needed for implementation and customization work.
Ability to clearly explain the Epicor Kinetic projects supported, implementation responsibilities, modules involved, and specific customizations personally completed.

Key Responsibilities

Support Epicor Kinetic implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and issue resolution.
Translate business requirements into practical Epicor Kinetic configurations and customizations.
Build or modify screens, fields, layouts, workflows, forms, and user experiences in Epicor Kinetic.
Develop and maintain BAQs, BPMs, Epicor Functions, user defined fields or tables, validations, business logic, reports, and integrations as required.
Troubleshoot Epicor Kinetic customization, workflow, integration, and data issues and document completed changes.
Provide clear technical documentation and knowledge transfer for completed work.

Preferred Experience

Epicor Data Management Tool, SSRS, C#, custom reporting, manufacturing, engineering, job management, purchasing, inventory, finance, or project based business processes.

Contract Engagement

This is a contract-only opportunity, not a regular full-time Petrotech position.

Project scope, duration, schedule, and compensation will be based on experience and defined implementation needs.

What to Include When Applying

Your resume should clearly identify the Epicor Kinetic employer or project, your implementation role, modules supported, and examples of Epicor Kinetic customizations you personally completed.

Applications that do not demonstrate direct experience with Epicor Kinetic customization will not be advanced for consideration.

Work Location: Remote
